'''Futrad''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She was stationed aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Futrad appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the Recruit PvP Gear Vendor for the Jedi Knight class, though she was later removed during a reorganization of the gear system.<ref name="TOR" />
